summary: Comprehensive testing of 3 new features: 1) Architecture Refactoring - ProjectDetailPage decomposed into KanbanBoard, TaskListView, CreateTaskDialog, ProjectSettingsDialog components, 2) Real-time Notification Badges with WebSocket integration, 3) Email Notifications for Approval Events. All backend tests pass (18/18). Frontend UI testing confirms all refactored components work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug in task_router.py line 192: check_approval_required returns 3 values (requires_approval, rule, workflow) but code was only unpacking 2. Changed to: requires_approval, rule, workflow = await approval_service.check_approval_required(...)
seed_data_creation: Test tasks created during testing are cleaned up automatically
context_for_next_testing_agent: Three features tested: 1) Refactored ProjectDetailPage components (KanbanBoard, TaskListView, CreateTaskDialog, ProjectSettingsDialog) all working correctly with proper data-testid attributes. 2) Real-time notifications via WebSocket with auto-reconnection implemented in AppLayout.jsx. 3) Email service has send_approval_requested, send_approval_approved, send_approval_rejected methods integrated into approval_service.py.

architecture_refactoring.KanbanBoard: 4 columns (To Do, In Progress, In Review, Done) with task cards, drag-drop ready
architecture_refactoring.TaskListView: 10 task rows with checkboxes and status toggle buttons
architecture_refactoring.CreateTaskDialog: Opens with Title, Description, Priority, Status, Assignees, Dates, Recurrence fields
architecture_refactoring.ProjectSettingsDialog: Opens with Task Statuses and Approval Workflows tabs

notification_system.notification_dropdown: Shows 'No notifications' when empty, displays notification items when present
notification_system.mark_all_read: Button available when unread notifications exist

email_service.send_approval_requested: Method exists and is called when approval is requested
email_service.send_approval_approved: Method exists and is called when approval is approved
email_service.send_approval_rejected: Method exists and is called when approval is rejected

backend_api_tests: Notification API (get, unread count, mark as read, mark all as read)
Tasks API (list, create, update status, delete)

bug_fixed.issue: ValueError: too many values to unpack (expected 2)
bug_fixed.cause: check_approval_required returns 3 values but code was unpacking only 2
